name: Let It Riff
detailed_description:
Let It Riff is an online multiplayer party game. Create hilarious combinations using prompts and player submitted answers, express yourself to your peers with custom reactions, and much more!

Gameplay

Grab you and up to 9 other friends in an online party experience. The objective is simple - to fill in the blank, but filling in the blank isn't going to earn the vote of your fellow players. Come up with funny, unique, interesting, or just plain wacky answers to earn the respect of both yourself, and your gang of part-time comedians!

Streamers Behold!

Don't have any friends? - No worries!

For those who enjoy streaming your games to the world, enjoy some quality of life features that will help you run games more smoothly, specifically for Twitch (as of now):

  • Kick troublesome players anytime during the game.

  • Add additional blocked phrases specifically for your audience.

  • Have the piece of mind that your players can only join using a verified Twitch account.

All About Community

Party games are all about friends so we made sure to add many ways for you to communicate and encounter silly moments with your party. 

  • Global reaction system, whenever, wherever.

  • Unique avatars to express your role in the group.

In-Game Safety

Go ahead, tell that joke your friends hate.

Although Let It Riff has built-in functionality to block commonly used phrases such as slurs and other remarks that could be hurtful to players in the community, adult language and themes are fully allowed!

Alright, still not enough for you?

If you felt uncomfortable by an answer, you can report it! This has no impact on the player who submitted it, however our team will manually review it and determine if it meets certain criteria.
